finalPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One production transparent sprite atlas for Dream Town. Cell 6 branches upper-left, lower-right, lower-left. Cell 7 branches upper-left, upper-right, lower-left. Cell 8 branches upper-left, upper-right, lower-right. Every branch same thickness and length.
